task_context.problem_statement: Arthur wants to sell his basketball card collection and use the money to buy comic books. The store owner tells him that each card is worth 5 cents and comic books cost $6 each. If Arthur sells all 2,000 cards of his and buys as many comic books as he can, how much money does he have leftover?

Fine. 2000 times 0.05 is 100. So he has 100 dollars. Now what?
